title: Coffee in green mug
notes: Low-key close-up on a dark table: two hands set a green ceramic cup of latte (leaf latte art) on its saucer, let go and slowly withdraw (6.2-7.8 s); the cup then sits alone and still. A quiet 'put it down and pause' beat for '한 번 더 생각해 볼 틈', leading into P42 (hands reopening the notebook). Hands only, no face; plain cup, no logos or text (checked at 1080p). Dark, warm; matches the channel.

title: Poker chips and a pair of dice
notes: Two white dice drop into frame (~2.6 s), tumble across green felt among red/blue/black casino chips and settle (~7.5 s): an outcome that has left your hands, i.e. luck's share (운의 몫). Dice stay readable under the 3-line centre blur. No people. Chips carry only '5' numerals, no casino name or logo; no other text (checked at 1080p). Mid-tone studio shot, colourful; default grade fine.

backup.why: Man in a denim shirt (torso and hands only, face out of frame) shakes two dice, throws them at ~5.5 s and they land among the chip stacks at ~6.3 s; 10 s, continuous; Free.

title: Focus Pull from Raindrops to Payphone
notes: Dark teal shot through rain-beaded glass: first only the droplets are sharp and the object behind is a blur, then focus racks through to a wall payphone (handset, keypad) that is sharp from ~3.9 s: literally 'blurry, then in focus' for '이유부터 흐릿했다면 / 다음에 고칠 점이 생긴 거고요' (line 1 on the blur, line 2 as focus lands). No people. A small coin-return plate reads 'DEVOLUCION DE MONEDAS' (generic Spanish, not a brand): blur_box given and verified on 1080-scaled frames (it is also illegible under the centre blur); otherwise keypad digits only. Source is 720p only (1280x720; Mixkit's original asset is this same file); fine under the centre blur. Dark.

(Candle and grass-in-wind clips I liked were Restricted.)

backup.title: Branches swaying in the wind

title: Electrical storm in the mountains
notes: Night: a mountain ridge in black silhouette while lightning flickers inside a cloud bank behind it (bursts at ~3.0, 4.5 and 6.7-7.5 s), stars above: a signal suddenly lighting up in the dark, standing in for the fMRI 'regret signal' (Free brain/neuron imagery was not available; all such clips were Restricted). Static camera; the scene-detector spikes are the lightning flashes, not cuts (checked frame by frame). No people, no text. Dark, cinematic; the bottom subtitles sit over the dark ridge.

Relaxed and unhurried for '그리고 다시 볼 때는 이렇게 물어보세요', leading into P46 (calm face at the phone). No face; no logo visible on the phone or watch (checked at 1080p). Bright (overexposed window, mean luma ~0.49).

backup.title: Hands shown texting on a smartphone

title: Train arriving to a subway station
notes: Dark, empty underground platform (tiled wall, hanging clock, light strip): train carriages glide past at the platform edge with nobody waiting, the train going by without you, for '더 나은 선택을 놓쳤죠'. Mixkit's title says 'arriving'; the in-point is after the head car (with its headlight) has passed, so the span shows only carriages sliding past (the train stops ~15 s, outside the span). No visible people (windows dark or motion-blurred). A small blue car label and an illegible dark marking pass on one car at ~8.6-9.0 s (motion-blurred, unreadable, no brand). Dark, cinematic. (The Restricted 'purple train leaving' clip was my first idea.)

Looks different from st32's sandy beach (forest creek vs. shoreline). (Balanced-stone clips were Restricted.)

title: Sad girl looking out the window
notes: A young woman (adult, seen from behind) stands at a window with one hand on the glass, looking out at a snowy winter view: wistful and reflective, for the inner thought '그때 내가 너무 좋은 쪽으로만 생각했었던 것 같아'. Person at a window as requested (not a plain rainy window). Back view through the whole span; the camera drifts sideways and only the hair-covered edge of her cheek appears in the last frames (~3.8-3.9 s); her profile becomes clear only after ~4.0 s, so do not extend past 3.95 s. No text or logos. Very bright (white window, mean luma ~0.59); the renderer darkens it, and her dark silhouette stays a strong shape under the centre blur.
